kitDescription: Harran is an Electric SR sniper Attacker whose attacks have a 25% chance to infect the target with Virus Transfer, a damage-over-time that ticks for 17.28% of her ATK every second for 5 seconds. When an infected enemy dies, the virus spreads to the 2 nearest other enemies. Every full-charge shot — which for a sniper is effectively every shot — grants her Pierce and a +2.95% Critical Rate buff for one round, and each kill she scores stacks +3.02% ATK up to fifteen times. Her burst is a single 999% of final ATK hit to all enemies. On the single immortal scope-lock boss the kill-triggered spread and ATK-stack lines can never fire, so her live kit there is the DoT, the per-shot self-buffs, and the nuke.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every divergence from literal prose is a documented ⚑ with an estimate, tier, and recipe, and the two out-of-domain kill lines are verbatim-unmodeled with anti-fabrication pins. The blind re-derivations converged on every load-bearing encoding — the everyN:4 proc thinning, the burstCast keying (discriminated against fullBurstEnter in a fixture where the two genuinely diverge), the pierce re-arm shape (the driver's version is strictly more faithful than the blind's lapsing 1.3s wall-clock proxy), and the kill-line rulings. The single S5 RED is mechanism over-specification, not a driver error: the blind pinned the literal durationShots:1 shape, which the driver shows — via an executed vitest pin (literal encoding per-frame crit rates identical to the line being absent), not self-report — to be net-inert in this engine; the driver's steady-state passive proxy reproduces the kit's re-trigger steady state that S2b independently derived as the correct semantics, and the crit lift is verified live by counterfactual in both suites. Per non-negotiable 4 the executed pin is an independent method and the bar is met. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: (1) the 2026-08-05 probe claim that a shotFired-granted durationShots:1 buff self-consumes on its granting frame — if that engine reading were ever overturned, the literal encoding becomes preferable to the proxy and the ⚑2 engine-primitive recipe (noRetriggerWhileActive generalized + durationShots on gainPierce) is the tracked fix; (2) a documentation nit, not a finding — the driver note's 'DoT non-crit (engine default)' is stale against the SSOT's DOT_CRIT default-ON, but the encoding carries no crit field so behavior follows the engine default either way. Nothing must change for GO.
